t: Titan TTI1257COM 18V cordless combi drill is a reliable and versatile tool for drilling, hammer drilling, and screwdriving. Powered by 2 x 2.0Ah TXP Li-Ion batteries for extended runtime and continuous, uninterrupted work. Delivers up to 50Nm of torque and features 22 torque settings for precise control, and drills through 35mm wood and 13mm steel with ease. Features 2-speed variable transmission, 13mm keyless chuck, and soft-grip ergonomic handle to make it comfortable and easy to use over extended periods. Also equipped with LED worklight, brake system, spindle lock and charger. Ideal for DIY and professional projects. Supplied 2 x 18V (2.0Ah) battery packs and 2.4A charger. Part of the TXP battery system.
b: 22 Torque Settings + Drill + Hammer Drill + Screwdriver
